verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a skill pack could ship skills that act on many items at once, but the evidence only glances at it. The triage skill sorts raw issues (plural) through a state machine, and another skill splits a spec into many small tickets, but nothing describes acting on a batch of items in one operation. Missing for 10: explicit batch or bulk operation support (e.g., bulk triage or bulk ticket updates), documentation of multi-item execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
